kind: Bounded read-only GPU-adoption integration review; not adoption evidence
approval_gate: Do not adopt until the registered accuracy checks AND at least 1.25x full-wall speedup versus the faster fresh CPU benchmark pass. Keep CUDA optional otherwise.
inspection_scope: Small local preparation, audit, runner, archive and reproduction source/configuration records only. No installed-library hashing, SDK/build traversal or large-field reads during timing.

Preserve it unchanged.

scientific_limits: Build/device/MPI readiness is not CFD accuracy, speed, stationarity or convergence validation.

A 922576-cell frozen 0.6–0.62 s pressure benchmark does not establish the speedup of smaller cold-start spacing seeds or their 0.8–1.2 s lift statistics. Avoid a blanket runtime claim across those protocols.
No force or power rescaling, loss-map change, source-model change or altered stopping criteria should be used to make CUDA pass.
A new stronger production method digest identifies an unchanged approved GKO implementation plus a fuller closure; preserve the frozen experimental digest rather than rewriting benchmark provenance.
